about_the_game:
Synopsis.

□□ wakes up in a strange office. □□□ has lost his memory.

A woman claiming to be a consulting private detective is by his side and seems to know □□□.

Find out why he lost his memory.

Game description.

Element : Riddle solving, mystery, detective, (yuri)

Duration: 30-40 minutes

Difficulty level: casual

Main heroine.

Japanese name: Yaka Sharoku

English name: Sharok Holmes

>Profile.

158 cm, 48 kg, type AB, born 1/6, 27 years old.

Gender: female.

Occupation, advisory private detective.

The only consulting private detective in Japan who is a member of the police force.

Born in London, graduated first in her law degree from the University of Cambridge, specialising in law.

Specialist in psychology, anthropology and forensic science.

He has used his abilities to solve a number of difficult cases.

On official papers, he appears to be descended from a lineage descended from Holmes' brother.

At first glance, he may appear to be a light-tempered, soft-hearted womaniser.

In fact, like his ancestors,

He takes pride in being a good guardian of law and order and

He fulfils the duties of a detective.

short_description: Scientific circumstantial evidence, eyewitness testimony and objective facts are needed for deductions. You have to mesh these together to get an answer. As my grandfather, the great detective Holmes, once told me. The remaining possibilities are the truth.
